_note: DRAFT N8nHealthContract@v1 for lane n8n-comms-intent-consumer (2026-10-15). Not in config/n8n_health_contracts.json on purpose: the gate refuses a DRAFT for a lane that was not grandfathered (DRAFT_NOT_GRANDFATHERED), and the lane is NEVER_SCHEDULED, so no contract is required yet (MISSING_CONTRACT applies from stage shadow). The owner reviews this body, sets status REVIEWED with a review block, and moves it into config/n8n_health_contracts.json in the registry PR that stages the lane at shadow. tests/test_n8n_comms_intent_consumer_20261015.py validates it with scripts/lib/n8n_health_contracts.validate_contract.
target_reason: Proposed n8n-native host lane fired through Run Lane; staged NEVER_SCHEDULED with an allowlist entry at shadow (live_arg null).

purpose.text: Turn QUEUED n8n comms intents (gateway comms/intent) into incident fan-in incidents at the route's tier, deduped per workflow and kind, so they reach the operator only through the incident notifier's existing P2 batch. Claims QUEUED -> CLAIMED -> DONE/FAILED; sends nothing.

connects_to.name: data/governance/n8n_coordination_ledger.sqlite comms_intents
connects_to.source: SELECT QUEUED/FAILED/expired-CLAIMED rows; UPDATE state only (compare-and-set inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE)

connects_to.name: data/governance/n8n_coordination_ledger.sqlite comms_intent_consumption, comms_intent_incidents
connects_to.source: Additive tables owned by this lane (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on --apply only)

connects_to.name: config/n8n_comms_intent_routes.json
connects_to.source: Closed (domain, kind) -> tier table, re-read every run

connects_to.name: scripts/n8n_incident_fanin.py
connects_to.source: _comms_intent_findings reads the open incidents and dead letters mode=ro

connects_to.name: data/runtime/n8n-comms-intent-consumer_last.json
connects_to.source: LaneRunReceipt@v1 on --apply only; ok_at advances only on success; dry run writes nothing

healthy.text: Every apply run exits 0 with ok_at advanced; no comms intent stays QUEUED longer than one cadence plus the 10 min claim lease.
At most one OPEN comms_intent_incidents row per (workflow, kind); every DONE intent names its incident_key and fanin_event_key.

degraded.text: An intent FAILED transiently (attempts < 3) and waits for the next run; or the run deferred intents beyond the per-run cap.

failed.text: An intent FAILED 3 times or refused (no route, PAGE tier): fan-in finding n8n_comms_intent_dlq/dead_letter (P2).
An intent QUEUED for more than 2 h: fan-in finding n8n_comms_intent_dlq/queued_stale (P2); the lane is not running.
The LaneRunReceipt is missing, failed or older than freshness_failed_after_h.

baseline.source: Proposed */5 cadence through Run Lane; owner review pending

alerting.severity_basis: ALERT_TAXONOMY.md §2: a stuck intent delays a DIGEST line; no money at risk in the next hour
alerting.routing: Existing host fan-in -> incident notifier P2 batch. Never PAGE: the P1 path does not depend on n8n (AGENTS.md §24.1).

remediation.note: Manual: read the receipt and comms_intent_consumption.last_error; fix the cause; a dead-lettered intent is re-queued only by an operator (packet 04_rollback.md).

verify: one operator --apply (packet 03_apply.md) and the fan-in note showing the incident
